messages:
Sam Carter: incident-bot: page fired -> PD:EDGE-LB-TLS-HIGH - edge load balancer TLS handshake error rate > 5% for prod-eu
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-1724 created and auto-page sent to oncall.

PagerDuty: Page triggered by alert rule `edge.tls.handshake.rate` (threshold breach). Alert links: https://pd.example/INC-1724

Sam Carter: ack'd oncall. I'm on it. :rotating_light:

Maya Li: I see the same, jumping in. Which fleets are affected? prod-eu only?

Sam Carter: dashboards show spike in 504/TLS handshake failures concentrated on lb-targets in eu-west-1. Low traffic in us-east.

Leo Park: I'm getting backend target health flapping in ALB. `TargetHealthDescription` reports `TLS handshake failed` for several targets in k8s svc redwood-edge (namespace=networking, port=443)

Anya Gómez: Any recent cert rotates or config changes? I just checked cert-rotation job logs, last succeeded 3d ago. No changes in infra config PRs in the last 24h.

Priya Shah: Customer success flagged a few customers reporting increased latency and request failures to the API. CS running an impact list.

Sam Carter: quick triage plan: 1) validate NAT/egress and upstream TLS (OCSP/cert) 2) confirm LB target health 3) failover to secondary regional pool if needed 4) limit blast radius via traffic steering

Maya Li: running dig/curl against edge IPs now:
```
$ dig +short www.redwood-inference.com @8.8.8.8
54.239.16.10

$ curl -v https://54.239.16.10/health
* TLS handshake error: error:1408F10B:SSL routines:ssl3_get_record:wrong version number
``` 
This matches TLS handshake fail seen in logs.

Leo Park: `kubectl get endpoints -n networking` shows several endpoints `NotReady`.

Anya Gómez: from ALB logs (snippet):
```
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z ALB: target: i-0abc TLS_ERROR handshake_failed
2026-03-15T12:04:05Z ALB: target: i-0def TLS_ERROR handshake_failed
```

ops-bot: Notifying infra-networking rotation oncall: @Maya, @Leo

Sam Carter: Maya/Leo, can one of you check whether recent kernel openssl/sidecar updates rolled to the fleet? Could be a cipher negotiation change.

Maya Li: I see a canary of `proxy-sidecar:v2.18.0` rolled 2h ago to ~3% of nodes in eu-west-1. That might explain partial failure.

Leo Park: Confirmed. Canary rollout is stuck with unhealthy targets. Rolling back the canary now to v2.17.5 on problematic nodes.

Maya Li: rollback command issued:
```
helm upgrade proxy-sidecar chart/proxy --set image.tag=v2.17.5 --namespace=networking
``` 
Monitoring target health.

Sam Carter: Good. Meanwhile, reduce ALB connection draining threshold and shift traffic weight away from eu-west-1 by 30% as a protective step.

Anya Gómez: Applying traffic steering policy to Route53 weighted record. Lower weight eu-west by 30%, increase eu-central by 30.

Sam Carter: Also lowering DNS TTL for the apex temporarily to 30s to speed up any future shifts.

Priya Shah: CS update: ~12 paying customers reported 502/504s in last 30m; none reported data loss, mostly degraded UX. We're prioritizing top-5 enterprise contacts for proactive outreach.

Maya Li: Rollback completed on most nodes; ALB target health improving. TLS handshake failure rate dropped from 6.2% -> 1.1% over last 5m.

Leo Park: I'm still seeing a couple stale node agents with old sidecar image; draining and restarting them.

Sam Carter: Good progress. Keep monitoring for 30m. If error rate stays <1% and ALB healthy, we can start restoring original traffic weights and TTL.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1724 acknowledged by Sam Carter at 2026-03-15T12:10:04Z

PagerDuty: No escalations required. Incident status: acknowledged -> investigating.

Maya Li: Follow-up: investigating why canary rollout landed on critical nodes - rollout strategy should be avoiding nodes with active targets. Opening a follow-up ticket in eng-infra: #INF-948.

Anya Gómez: I'm capturing container logs from the failed sidecar handshake for root cause.
```
ERR: tls: handshake error: tls: unsupported protocol
```
That looks like a sidecar built against openssl 3 cipher defaults causing server-client mismatch.

Sam Carter: Action items: 1) rollback (done) 2) emergency hotfix to disable new cipher set in v2.18.0 3) revert canary rollout policy until checksum validation added 4) outreach to customers

Priya Shah: CS message drafted and queued to top-5 affected customers. No raise to public status page yet; waiting for stabilization.

Leo Park: ALB targets now `Healthy` 5/5 across most pods. Error rate steady at 0.6%.

Sam Carter: Good. Start reverting traffic steering and restore DNS TTL to 300s once we hit 10m of stable healthy metrics.

Maya Li: metrics stable for 12m. Restoring weights and TTL now.

Anya Gómez: saved logs and capturing core dump for one of the failing sidecars for offline analysis. Creating a repro harness.

incident-bot: PagerDuty INC-1724 resolved by Sam Carter at 2026-03-15T12:38:22Z (cause: regression in proxy-sidecar v2.18.0 causing TLS cipher negotiation failures; mitigated via rollback and traffic steering)

PagerDuty: Incident resolved. Postmortem requested. Severity: SEV2. Time to acknowledge: 2m. Time to mitigate: 34m.

Sam Carter: Thanks everyone. ETA for a postmortem doc in eng-sre is EOD. Follow-up items assigned: INF-948 (rollout strategy), RUNTIME-1120 (cipher defaults validation), CS-564 (customer comms).

Priya Shah: I'll follow up with customers and close CS tickets once they confirm service restored.

Leo Park: Adding note to deploy playbook: prefer gradual canary avoiding nodes with high target weight.

Maya Li: One more: tagging the canary artifact to block automatic promo until validation tests pass.

Sam Carter: Great. Closing thread in 1h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Auto-archive scheduled for thread in 60 minutes.
